messages:
mira: Heads up — onboarding jobs in eu-west-2 are failing. A bunch of GPU nodes can't decrypt images: KMS Decrypt = AccessDenied. Started ~11:18 UTC. Not sure if it's a provisioning bug or network.

ajay: Can you paste the error lines? Which keystore?

mira: Logs from kubelet on new node: `E0321 11:18:02.123 kubelet] failed to fetch image config: Get "https://keystore-prod.internal.redwood:443/decrypt": dial tcp 10.4.8.22:443: connect: permission denied`

lara: Security rolled a tightened egress rule to reduce NAT blast radius earlier today (policy: egress-shielding-v2). Could be related. I wasn't on the change but saw the deploy.

deploy-bot: policy egress-shielding-v2 applied to stack vpc-eu-west-2 by kevin at 2026-03-21T10:45:00Z (change-id: chg-8721).

kevin: Yep that was me — we locked outbound to only allow customer-facing subnets + privatelink endpoints. I thought keystore traffic would use the privatelink but apparently the keystore in this prod slice uses a different internal hostname. Sorry, I'm looking.

ajay: Mira, can you confirm nodes are hitting the keystore IP above (10.4.8.22)? Any other denied logs?

mira: Yes, same IP across 4 failed nodes. Here's tail of syslog: `Mar 21 11:18:01 ip-10-0-5-73 kernel: firewall: DENIED outbound tcp to 10.4.8.22:443 (policy=e-shield-v2 sg=sg-0a1b2c)`

ops-bot: auditlog: denied_reqs=412, affected_resources=[gpu-nodepool-eu-20260321], top_dest=10.4.8.22:443, rule=egress-shielding-v2

lara: Noted. Two problems to balance: 1) we tightened egress to reduce attack surface (compliance ask), 2) we created a regression for GPU onboarding (availability/cost impact).

kevin: Quick workaround: add a short-lived allow for the keystore ENI range + tag `service:keystore-prod` for the gpu warm pool ASG. I can push an allow exception for 30m while we figure permanent fix. Thoughts?

ajay: Works for me, but we need audit trail and TTL. Add change-id and set to auto-revert. Also we should estimate cost — if we open NAT to keystore via privatelink later maybe cheaper.

lara: Approved for temporary exception. Please annotate in the change and include risk note. We should also add a ticket to migrate keystore to a privatelink-enabled endpoint for this region.

kevin: Pushing change now: `aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0a1b2c --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.4.8.16/28 --description "temp allow keystore decrypt for gpu warmpool chg-8722 ttl=30m"`

ops-bot: change chg-8722 created by kevin at 2026-03-21T11:22:31Z (auto-revert 30m).

mira: Retrying onboarding — now seeing successful KMS decrypts. GPU nodes are joining again. Thanks. 

ajay: Can we capture metrics on how many nodes failed and any billing delta from retries? We should include that in postmortem.

lara: I'll create INF ticket to track migration to privatelink + service discovery cleanup: INF-1341. Assign to platform team. Include cost estimate and rollout plan.

kevin: Action items I have: 1) follow-up PR to egress-shielding-v2 to whitelist keystore ENI via tag-based allow for ASG gpu-warmpool, 2) coordinate with platform to schedule privatelink cutover, 3) write short incident note.

mira: Please also add node-level retry backoff config to reduce repeated DNS+decrypt attempts causing pipeline thundering; that's contributing to provisioning load.

ajay: FYI — if we keep a long-term open egress for keystore we'll increase NAT costs. Privatelink avoids NAT egress and is the preferred path per compliance. Add cost delta numbers in INF-1341.

lara: Agreed. For now: keep the auto-revert, monitor for 1h, then reapply tightened rule once privatelink is live or the keystore hostname resolves over privatelink.

ops-bot: audit record appended: incident=INC-4321, severity=low, impact=GPU onboarding delays ~30m, actions=[temp allow chg-8722, INF-1341 created].

kevin: Thanks — will draft a 1-paragraph postmortem and attach logs.

mira: Great — cc @platform on INF-1341. Also posting short blurb to #all-hands tomorrow about egress-hardening tradeoffs and the plan. :white_check_mark:

ajay: Thanks everyone. Closing loop once INF-1341 has tech plan. :thumbsup:
